tool.name: Multimodal Learner
tool.description: Train and evaluate an AutoGluon Multimodal model

exit_code.description: Error occurred. Please check Tool Standard Error

tool.command:
#import re
## Sanitize filenames #if $input_csv #set train_csv = re.sub(r'[^\w\-_\\.]', '_', str($input_csv.element_identifier)) ln -sf '$input_csv' './$train_csv' && #end if
#if $test_dataset_conditional.has_test_dataset == 'yes' and $test_dataset_conditional.input_test #set test_csv = re.sub(r'[^\w\-_\\.]', '_', str($test_dataset_conditional.input_test.element_identifier)) ln -sf '$test_dataset_conditional.input_test' './$test_csv' && #end if
## Collect image columns (only when images are enabled) #set image_cols = [] #if str($use_images_conditional.use_images).lower() in ['yes', 'true', '1', 'on'] #for $i in range(1, 11) #set col = getattr($use_images_conditional.image_columns_block, 'image_column_' + str($i), None) #if $col and str($col).strip() #silent $image_cols.append(str($col).strip()) #end if #end for #end if
## Collect text columns (only when text is enabled) #set text_cols = [] #if str($use_text_conditional.use_text).lower() in ['yes', 'true', '1', 'on'] #for $i in range(1, 11) #set col = getattr($use_text_conditional.text_columns_block, 'text_column_' + str($i), None) #if $col and str($col).strip() #silent $text_cols.append(str($col).strip()) #end if #end for #end if
# Compute CLI-friendly booleans (coerced to strings) #set use_images_cli = 'true' if $image_cols else 'false' #set use_text_cli = 'true' if $text_cols else 'false' #set missing_image_strategy_cli = 'true' if getattr($use_images_conditional, 'missing_image_strategy', False) else 'false' #set cross_validation_cli = 'true' if getattr($customize_defaults_conditional, 'cross_validation', False) else 'false'
python '$__tool_directory__/multimodal_learner.py' \ --input_csv_train './$train_csv' \ #if $test_dataset_conditional.has_test_dataset == 'yes' and $test_dataset_conditional.input_test --input_csv_test './$test_csv' \ #end if --target_column '$target_column' \ --use_images '$use_images_cli' \ --use_text '$use_text_cli' \ --missing_image_strategy '$missing_image_strategy_cli' \ #if $image_cols --image_columns #for $c in $image_cols '$c' #end for \ #end if #if $text_cols --text_columns #for $c in $text_cols '$c' #end for \ #end if #if str($use_images_conditional.use_images).lower() in ['yes','true','1','on'] and $use_images_conditional.images_zip --images_zips '$use_images_conditional.images_zip' \ #end if #if $threshold --threshold $threshold \ #end if #if $time_limit --time_limit $time_limit \ #end if --random_seed $random_seed \
#if $backbone_tabular --backbone_tabular '$backbone_tabular' \ #end if #if str($use_images_conditional.use_images).lower() in ['yes','true','1','on'] and $use_images_conditional.backbone_image --backbone_image '$use_images_conditional.backbone_image' \ #end if #if str($use_text_conditional.use_text).lower() in ['yes','true','1','on'] and $use_text_conditional.backbone_text --backbone_text '$use_text_conditional.backbone_text' \ #end if #if $backbone_fusion --backbone_fusion '$backbone_fusion' \ #end if #if $preset --preset '$preset' \ #end if #if $eval_metric --eval_metric '$eval_metric' \ #end if
## Advanced customization #if $customize_defaults_conditional.customize_defaults == 'yes' #if $customize_defaults_conditional.validation_size not in [None, ""] --validation_size $customize_defaults_conditional.validation_size \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.split_probabilities #set probs = [x.strip() for x in str($customize_defaults_conditional.split_probabilities).split(',') if x.strip()] #if len($probs) == 3 --split_probabilities $probs[0] $probs[1] $probs[2] \ #end if #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.val_size_with_test not in [None, ""] --val_size_with_test $customize_defaults_conditional.val_size_with_test \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.cross_validation --cross_validation '$cross_validation_cli' \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.num_folds not in [None, ""] --num_folds $customize_defaults_conditional.num_folds \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.epochs not in [None, ""] --epochs $customize_defaults_conditional.epochs \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.learning_rate not in [None, ""] --learning_rate $customize_defaults_conditional.learning_rate \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.batch_size not in [None, ""] --batch_size $customize_defaults_conditional.batch_size \ #end if #if $customize_defaults_conditional.hyperparameters --hyperparameters '$customize_defaults_conditional.hyperparameters' \ #end if #end if
--output_csv '$output_csv' \ --output_json '$output_json' \ --output_html '$output_html' \ --output_config '$output_config' \
&& mkdir -p '$output_model.extra_files_path' \ && echo "Multimodal Learner finished successfully"

param.name: input_csv
param.label: Multimodal input dataset
param.help: CSV with features (and optional image paths)

param.name: backbone_tabular
param.label: Structured backbone
param.option: categorical_mlp - Custom MLP (no pretrained checkpoint; architecture only)
numerical_mlp - Custom MLP (no pretrained checkpoint; architecture only)

param.name: has_test_dataset
param.label: Do you have a separate test dataset?
param.help: Switch to "Yes" to upload a dedicated test CSV; keep "No" to create a train/val split from the input dataset.

param.name: input_test
param.label: Multimodal Test dataset
param.help: If omitted, a split is created from the input dataset

param.name: backbone_fusion
param.label: Fusion backbone
param.help: Fusion module that combines modalities before the prediction head

param.name: eval_metric
param.label: Evaluation metric
param.help: Choose the AutoGluon metric used to select the best performing model

param.name: threshold
param.label: Binary decision threshold
param.help: If set (0–1), use this cutoff to convert probabilities to labels for Train/Val/Test metrics and plots.

param.name: customize_defaults
param.label: Customize Default Settings?
param.help: Switch to "Yes" to tweak split settings, training schedule, and hyperparameters

param.name: val_size_with_test
param.label: Validation fraction (when test CSV is provided)

param.name: cross_validation
param.label: Use cross-validation
param.help: If true, run k-fold cross-validation on train+val combined

param.name: num_folds
param.label: Number of folds
param.help: Number of folds when cross_validation is enabled

param.name: hyperparameters
param.label: Hyperparameters (JSON or shorthand)
param.help: Pass AutoGluon hyperparameters as a JSON string or shorthand

tool.help: **AutoGluon Multimodal Learner** Trains and evaluates an AutoGluon MultiModal model using tabular data and, optionally, images.
